title: Add [capabilities.study] table to athena.toml
summary: Add only an empty-grant [capabilities.study] table to athena.toml, so the reader can pick study and the file still parses. The earlier attempt failed because it added an unknown source_branch field; the firstmate pinning is left for the next job.

defaults_applied.how: Only the [capabilities.study] table is added, and the pinning work waits for the next job.
The existing config-parsing tests and the landing gate's 'configuration parses' check enforce that athena.toml stays valid.
The verifier runs cargo test, clippy and fmt --check.
I read CapabilityConfig in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs to find the required fields, rather than asking.

assumptions: The study capability is already registered in crates/athena-cli/src/wiring.rs. The reader's choices come from the capabilities that have a config section, so the missing [capabilities.study] table is the only thing keeping the reader from picking it.

Study sessions need no Bash commands yet, so both command maps are empty. This is the smallest section that parses, because CapabilityConfig requires both fields, denies unknown fields, and defaults env and checks.
The firstmate pinning (source_branch and the study fetch-pinned work) is out of scope and is the next job.
The CHANGELOG line that says study has no configured checks or commands stays true after this change, so CHANGELOG.md needs no edit.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml gains a [capabilities.study] table with producer_commands = {} and verifier_commands = {} (both fields are required by CapabilityConfig), and no other field, such as source_branch or any firstmate pinning.
No other section of athena.toml changes, and no Rust source file is modified.
Run `cargo test --locked`: the tests that load athena.toml pass, so the file still parses and the study capability is registered against its config section.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`: both are clean.
The athena.toml header comment or a comment on the new table says the table is the study capability's first configuration and that source pinning comes in a later job.

out_of_scope: Pinning the study source to a branch or SHA, including the source_branch field and the firstmate pinning (the next job).
Any change to Rust code, including the study crate and CapabilityConfig.
Study checks, env, or Bash command grants.
Fixing the earlier job's source.rs full-clone concern.
departures: The change is a few lines of config with no code, so I expect it to cost and take less than the reference. The earlier attempt failed only on an unknown field, which this request avoids.
